statement.zh: 政治史综述常以「苏萨与安善之王」一类头衔概括低地—高地双中心结构（Carter & Stolper 1984；Potts 2016）。
statement.en: Political-history syntheses often summarize a lowland–highland dual-centre structure via titles such as ‘king of Susa and Anshan’ (Carter & Stolper 1984; Potts 2016).
